facts.business: Alliance Integrated Metaliks Limited manufactures heavy steel superstructures for infrastructure projects including steel bridges, foot over bridges, high-rise buildings, thermal power plants, marine equipment, stadiums, airport superstructures, refineries, commercial buildings, and automobile plants.
key_risks: Price Increase in Inputs (Diesel, Steel, Metal costs)
Operational Risks (Supply chain, employee productivity, health and safety, environmental impact, reputation)
Financial Risks (Liquidity constraints, NPA classification, inability to meet lender obligations, inadequate non-fund based working capital lines)
Legal and Compliance Risks (Provisional Attachment Order by Directorate of Enforcement, ongoing litigation)
